name: mdh-lookup-join-then-match
summary: Match a parent entity, $lookup-join to a sub-collection, then match the child record by code.
notes: Two-level hierarchical lookup; the $lookup runs after the parent match narrows the set. This fragment is the query half of a MatchConfig only — it writes nothing until you add the mapping/result_actions block that lands the matched row on your schema fields, which is why produces is empty.
